about: The star chooser's Kinds (ED6 part 2, editing design section 9). A kind is a phase of a star's life, with the spectral letters it must show where that matters; the chooser finds the mass that is that kind at the system's present age on the kernel's life line (describe_star), so no mass or age is typed here. prefer_msun only picks among several masses that all qualify. Move these into the class atlas once it has star classes.
letters_about: Spectral letter from the surface temperature, the usual main-sequence boundaries of the Morgan-Keenan classes (O B A F G K M) and the brown dwarf letters L T Y: a star at or above from_k (and below the previous row) takes the letter.
